# Tokyo 3-Day Food Trip Plan

A reservation-free, budget-aware food route for 2 adults centered on ramen, sushi, izakaya, and one vegetarian-friendly dinner. I’ve kept each day near **18,000 JPY total** and chosen places where walk-in dining is typically practical.

## Day-by-Day Dining Plan

### Day 1: Shinjuku + Shibuya ramen and izakaya
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- **Breakfast — Ichiran Shinjuku Central East Exit**
  - Estimated cost: **2,200 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Solo-booth ramen is fast, reliable, and easy for walk-ins; great first meal after arrival.
- **Lunch — Uobei Shibuya Dogenzaka**
  - Estimated cost: **4,000 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Conveyor-style sushi with quick service and no reservation needed; good value for a sushi-focused lunch.
- **Dinner — Hanbey Shinjuku Main Store**
  - Estimated cost: **8,000 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Casual izakaya atmosphere, broad menu, and a strong fit for beer, skewers, and shared plates.
- **Snack / late bite — convenience-store onigiri or dessert**
  - Estimated cost: **1,500 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Keeps the day flexible without pushing the budget.

**Day total: 15,700 JPY**

### Day 2: Asakusa + Ueno sushi and ramen
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

- **Breakfast — Freshness Burger / café breakfast near Asakusa**
  - Estimated cost: **2,000 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Easy walk-in breakfast that keeps the day light before heavier meals.
- **Lunch — Sushiro Ueno**
  - Estimated cost: **4,500 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Affordable sushi chain with fast turnover and no reservation requirement; good for a mid-trip sushi meal.
- **Dinner — Ippudo Ueno**
  - Estimated cost: **6,500 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Popular ramen spot with consistent quality and walk-in access; good comfort-food dinner.
- **Snack — taiyaki or soft serve in Asakusa**
  - Estimated cost: **1,500 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Light, local, and easy to fit between sightseeing stops.

**Day total: 14,500 JPY**

### Day 3: Ginza + Tokyo Station vegetarian-friendly dinner
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg

- **Breakfast — Kayaba Coffee or similar kissaten-style café**
  - Estimated cost: **2,500 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Relaxed start, walk-in friendly, and a nice contrast to the ramen/sushi-heavy trip.
- **Lunch — Genki Sushi Ginza**
  - Estimated cost: **4,500 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Casual sushi with fast service and budget control; easy for 2 adults without booking ahead.
- **Dinner — T’s Tantan Tokyo Station**
  - Estimated cost: **5,500 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Strong vegetarian-friendly choice with ramen-style dishes, convenient location, and no reservation needed.
- **Late snack — sake bar bite or dessert**
  - Estimated cost: **1,500 JPY**
  - Why it fits: Leaves room for a final small treat while staying under budget.

**Day total: 14,000 JPY**

## Budget Check

| Day | Planned Spend | Budget | Cushion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Day 1 | 15,700 JPY | 18,000 JPY | 2,300 JPY |
| Day 2 | 14,500 JPY | 18,000 JPY | 3,500 JPY |
| Day 3 | 14,000 JPY | 18,000 JPY | 4,000 JPY |

## Best-Fit Notes

- **Ramen priority:** Ichiran, Ippudo, and T’s Tantan give you three different ramen-style experiences with easy walk-in access.
- **Sushi priority:** Uobei, Sushiro, and Genki Sushi keep costs controlled while still giving you multiple sushi meals.
- **Izakaya priority:** Hanbey is the clearest casual izakaya pick for a reservation-free dinner.
- **Vegetarian-friendly dinner:** T’s Tantan is the strongest dedicated fit and works well as your one vegetarian-focused evening.
- **Reservation rule:** All picks are chosen for typical walk-in use; busy peak hours may still mean a short wait.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Map the route](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Ichiran+Shinjuku+Central+East+Exit+Tokyo)
Action: [Button: Find more options](https://www.google.com/maps/search/ramen+sushi+izakaya+Tokyo)
Action: [Button: Vegetarian dining](https://www.google.com/maps/search/vegetarian+ramen+Tokyo)

- Uobei locations: https://www.genkisushi.co.jp/uobei/
- T’s Tantan: https://www.tstantan.com/
- Ippudo locations: https://en.ippudo.com/shop/
